blind.description: A heavy, medieval/fantasy-style stone throne with carved accents. It features a high back topped with a circular sunburst/radial medallion emblem flanked by squared finials/capstones, a red upholstered backrest panel and seat cushion, wide blocky stone armrests, and a low stepped stone plinth base. Draped over the right armrest is a textured animal fur pelt with light brown spots/edges. The rear shows the back of the tall slab with an inset red panel. Surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures; underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square-ish armchair footprint showing the thick backrest and side armrests framing the square red seat cushion, with the textured fur pelt clearly draped over the right armrest.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching roughly to the shoulder of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 feet wide across the armrests.
